format: UCWDC Couples, challenges to panel or results

source.quote_free_summary: A complaint or challenge to a judging panel's composition or results must be made post-event and goes to the Judge Review Board.

requirement: Challenges to judging decisions are handled by the UCWDC Judge Review Board, outside DanceFlow; DanceFlow must not present itself as adjudicating them or allow in-event reversal as a challenge outcome.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: engine, SQL, UI, report generation.
interpretation_notes: The Judge Certification Code of Conduct referenced by this rule is not in the provided sources (open gap, see OD-05/OD-15). The text names no procedure for DanceFlow to follow and no time limit.
decision_refs: OD-22 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B for initial Studio/Custom; Option A for future WSDC support, with UCWDC correction-authority restrictions; retrospective audit PR #795)
